reason: The hypothesis directly combines the observation of Cu-rich surface layer formation and premelting in CoCrCu from P2 with the size-dependent melting point depression in nanocrystalline CoCrFeNiMn from P6, applying this combined mechanism to FeNiCrCoCu nanoparticles. This is a straightforward synthesis of two existing findings without introducing a new mechanism or resolving a conflict, and the proposed test does not go beyond standard validation of the combined observations.

size-dependent melting point depression from P6
in-situ heating and elemental mapping as characterization
